visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark straight hair, wearing silver earrings and a black turtleneck with KITH logos, speaks directly to the camera in a brightly lit studio environment with a grey wall background. (2) Close-up shot focusing on the woman's face, showcasing her skin texture and subtle makeup. (3) She holds up a black jar labeled KANEBO, pointing at it while speaking. (4) The camera focuses on the back of a hand where a spatula spreads a light-colored foundation cream smoothly. (5) Using a white beauty blender, she dabs the foundation onto her cheek and blends it outwards toward the jawline. (6) A split-screen displays the right side of her face labeled Before and the left side After, highlighting the difference in skin tone and luminosity. (7) She opens a small black compact containing a gradient of three brown eyebrow powders and applies it with a brush. (8) She displays a black zippered makeup pouch and a styling brush. (9) Final shot of her smiling and framing her face with her hands, showing the completed makeup look.
